description: Batch-size-1 predictions of the frozen deployed artifact (E_lr5_q_only_Wi/model.int8.onnx, OnnxPredictor threads=8, one text per call) followed by the deployed oos rule apply_threshold(tau=0.4), baked into the vector exactly as in the frozen eval_probs.npy (so argmax flips == deployed decision flips). Dev predictions computed identically; calibrator refit on batch-1 dev with none/temperature, 5-fold CV NLL.
